claims: No. 1 seed Duke University defeated No. 2 seed University of Virginia 74-70 to win the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament Championship on March 14, 2026.
Duke won their second consecutive ACC Men's Basketball Tournament title under Jon Scheyer.
Duke won their 23rd overall ACC Men's Basketball Tournament title.
Duke secured an automatic bid to the 2026 NCAA tournament.
Duke Blue Devils were the champion of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
Virginia Cavaliers were the runner-up of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
The final score of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament Championship was 74-70.
The 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament Championship was on March 14, 2026.
The 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament Championship was in Charlotte, NC.
Duke defeated Florida State in the quarterfinals of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
Duke defeated Clemson in the semifinals of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
Virginia defeated NC State in the quarterfinals of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
Virginia defeated Miami in the semifinals of the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament.
Isaiah Evans led with 20 points in the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament final.
Malik Thomas scored 18 points in the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament final.
Sam Lewis scored 17 points in the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament final for Virginia.
Virginia's Ugonna Onyenso tied his season-high with eight blocks in the 2026 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament championship game.
